build: Modwerk's linker (kit 0.7.0 parity): core-ar2 0.3 release (6b97dfb3…3e58) + rytm2_mods v1.2 slice-loop-1.0-os1.74.elemod (b1b8f51b…1cf9), --version SL74
conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; FUNC + CHRO opens the track menu of BD, four DOWN select SLICE LOOP and YES chooses it. RECORD enters grid recording and SMPL opens the SAMPLE page; trig 2 and then trig 16 are held, each with a zero-count turn of encoder 1 only to take a frame while the key is down (the value does not change). RECORD leaves grid recording, and SLICE LOOP is chosen again. On stock 1.74 the same boot gives identical frames until the track menu opens, whose list ends at SAVE TRACK; the stock run was stopped there.
